breaking_news.headline: CNN, MS NOW and Politico prevail against White House — for now
breaking_news.summary: A federal judge ruled late Tuesday that President Trump cannot ban news organizations from covering him at the White House because he does not like the nature of their coverage - at least, not until the matter goes to a formal trial.

breaking_news.headline: The skincare scheme that led to consumer complaints, lawsuits and a federal investigation
breaking_news.summary: Free samples, high-pressure pitches and $50,000 bills: An NPR investigation reveals how a network of mall skincare stores systematically targeted older adults and people with disabilities across the U.S.

breaking_news.headline: VIDEO: The skincare sample is free. What happens next can cost thousands
breaking_news.summary: For years, customers have complained of aggressive sales tactics and charges at mall skincare stores. NPR investigated the business that connects many of them.

breaking_news.headline: Inflation sizzled in September — and Social Security benefits will get a boost
breaking_news.summary: Consumer prices in September jumped 3.7% from a year ago.  The Social Security Administration said benefits will increase next year to help keep pace with the rising cost of living.

breaking_news.headline: Social Security benefits to get a boost. And, Hasan Piker defends his rhetoric
breaking_news.summary: Social Security benefits are set to get a boost to offset rising consumer prices. And, streamer Hasan Piker says the GOP's "guilt-by-association politics" won't drag Democrats down in the midterms.

breaking_news.headline: Inside the race between Elon Musk and Jeff Bezos for control of outer space
breaking_news.summary: The Atlantic writer Josh Tyrangiel says Musk and Bezos each want to colonize the moon, mine its resources and launch thousands more satellites. He says their only real competition is each other.

breaking_news.headline: Weddings are expensive. How about a grocery store cake?
breaking_news.summary: About a third of couples are willing to save money on cake and dessert, according to the wedding-planning site Zola.

breaking_news.headline: At least 17 dead in crush at Hindu festival event in India
breaking_news.summary: Many more have been injured at an event in the Indian city of Kolkata to mark a Hindu festival.

breaking_news.headline: Anti-government protesters battle with police in Albania
breaking_news.summary: There were violent clashes between demonstrators and riot police throughout Saturday in the capital Tirana.

breaking_news.headline: Trump waives several Russia sanctions as row with Zelensky intensifies
breaking_news.summary: The US president temporarily ends many restrictions on Moscow recently passed by Congress over "national security" concerns.

breaking_news.headline: Several dead or injured in major fire at Canada military base
breaking_news.summary: Officials have not given a cause or death toll, citing the "very active and delicate" situation at Canadian Forces Base Wainwright.

breaking_news.headline: European diplomats attacked by Israeli settlers in West Bank
breaking_news.summary: The Israeli military condemns the violence but the prime minister's office says it is part of a "smear" campaign.

breaking_news.headline: A wave of homemade, synthetic drugs sweeps US and deepens crisis
breaking_news.summary: BBC News hears from users, dealers, prison and recovery workers as the country battles with a deadly new drug epidemic.

breaking_news.headline: Oil facilities hit in deadly overnight attack on St Petersburg
breaking_news.summary: At least one person was killed in the strikes, which also hit a data centre used by Russia's equivalent of Facebook.

breaking_news.headline: Burnt out cars and shattered glass on Paris streets after protests turn to riots and looting
breaking_news.summary: Around 1,800 people were arrested after nationwide protests saw outbreaks of violence and vandalism.

breaking_news.headline: Banks expect to be hit with higher taxes in Budget
breaking_news.summary: Senior banking executives have told the BBC they expect to be "on the menu" in the chancellor's Budget tax later this month.

breaking_news.headline: 'I took a chance on the whisky industry and I haven't looked back'
breaking_news.summary: Zoey Darnbrough had no idea there was a distillery near her home - now she has a top tourism role there.

breaking_news.headline: Living with a stink? Technology might help
breaking_news.summary: Smells from rubbish dumps and industrial facilities are being more carefully monitored.

breaking_news.headline: Turning the tides: Could hidden sea power energise our coastal towns?
breaking_news.summary: Engineer David Mummery has developed a tidal energy generator that he says can change lives for people living in coastal communities.
